verdict: No blocking findings; offline source/test review only, no live preflight success claim.
scope: Read-only source/test inspection, isolated-worker tests with injected model transport, pure reconstruction of preserved failed history. No live model/web, installation, source/harness modifications or commits.

test_results.suite: Product feedback and isolated planner worker

test_provenance: All tests used main .venv Python with PYTHONPATH=src in the named worktree; import paths and product/audit hashes asserted. Tool output is the reviewer receipt; no separate raw reviewer log. Final product bytes unchanged after test-only addition.

saved_failure_projection.scope: Deterministic replay of recorded responses/outputs only; no new model behavior or semantic success claimed.

assessments.constraints: Overflow-planner feedback representation changes explicitly. No stdout/stderr excerpts, fact/field selection, summarization, padding, or discarded output. Complete host originals remain accessible; research root and direct small-input path are byte-identical.
assessments.cost_and_cumulative_history: Exact backend size includes prefix/wrappers; only positive whole-iteration savings qualify; descending net saving with iteration tie-break. Prior references persist, new small observations inline when possible. Unfit control history fails locally and atomically.
assessments.immutability_and_errors: Only sealed complete iterations are exposed, as fresh deep copies with code/stdout/stderr/execution/final status. Receipts visibly flag stderr; failed final-ready block behavior remains. Multi-block and >1MB stderr recovery tested.
assessments.audit: Policy and initial conversation checked before replay dispatch. Each actual planner prompt is reconstructed from preceding model responses, complete executed blocks and exact prior externalizations. Read identities/ordering checked; model attempts remain distinct from workers. Existing partial/missing-completion behavior and old-policy compatibility remain.
assessments.generality: No task/site names, model/deadline/retry changes, automatic subcalls, supplied-candidate filtering or strict proposal/accounting relaxation.

limitations: Controls/model responses can still become too large after all profitable references; visible failure remains.
Model-selected oversized subcalls can still fail; no automatic decomposition or extra retries introduced.
Full output availability is not proof of semantic inspection or future proposal quality.
Audit verifies consistent provenance and representation, not every semantic claim.
Fresh live saved replays and parent-owned integrated verification remain necessary.
